dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Eagles (3-7) Week 12 Briefing: Friday Injury Report Ahead of Cowboys
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: RB Will Shipley (foot / illness) and LB Smael Mondon Jr. (ankle) logged limited practice reps Friday [Jimmy Kempski](https://www.phillyvoice.com/eagles-cowboys-week-12-injury-report-analysis-2026/). LB Arnold Ebiketie (oblique) and CB Jonathan Jones (ankle) did not practice Friday, while WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and TE Dallas Goedert (shin) practiced in full [Jimmy Kempski](https://www.phillyvoice.com/eagles-cowboys-week-12-injury-report-analysis-2026/).

Week 12 Cowboys Outlook: Nick Sirianni and DC Vic Fangio open installation for the Dallas Cowboys (5-6, DAL -8.5, HC Brian Schottenheimer, OC Klayton Adams & DC Christian Parker (Road Test))—a unit ranked #2 in Offensive EPA / Game (+8.90) as Philadelphia prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Brandon Lee Gowton](https://www.bleedinggreennation.com/philadelphia-eagles-game-information/191498/eagles-at-cowboys-week-12-prediction) [Pro Football Focus](https://www.pff.com/news/the-10-best-nfl-player-matchups-to-watch-in-week-12-2/).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 3-7 (4th in NFC East • #15 Seed in NFC), Philadelphia carries a 0.7% postseason projection, 0.7% NFC East division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/nfc-notes-cam-skattebo-brandon-aiyuk-joe-milton-commanders-eagles-giants/).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Philadelphia ranks #31 in Points / Game (16.7), #18 in Points Allowed / Game (23.7), #27 in Turnover Differential (-5), giving Nick Sirianni and Vic Fangio a clear benchmark ahead of Thu, Nov 26, 4:30 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Dallas Cowboys [philadelphiaeagles.com Official](https://www.philadelphiaeagles.com/news/thanksgiving-game-preview-eagles-at-cowboys-six-storylines-to-follow-2026-nfl-week-12-joe-milton-saquon-barkley-dak-prescott-cee-dee-lamb).
